message: Hi, my trail running shoes from order ORD-1042 arrived with the sole coming off. Can I get a refund please?

evidence.sql:
SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, delivery_date, product_name, category, unit_price, quantity, order_total, payment_method, status, final_sale
FROM shop_orders.orders
WHERE order_id = 'ORD-1042' AND customer_id = 'C003'

SELECT refund_id, customer_id, order_id, request_date, amount, reason, decision
FROM support_desk.refund_history
WHERE customer_id = 'C003'

SELECT rule_id, category, reason_type, window_days, auto_approve_limit, outcome, rule_text
FROM policy_kb.refund_policy
WHERE category = 'Shoes' AND reason_type = 'defective'
UNION ALL
SELECT rule_id, category, reason_type, window_days, auto_approve_limit, outcome, rule_text
FROM policy_kb.refund_policy
WHERE category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: Defective shoes received within 30 days of delivery (15 days since delivery per E1); order total $89.00 under the $200.00 auto-approve limit (E1); not final sale (E1); 0 approved refunds in last 90 days (E2); policy R3 approves defective items within 30 days with auto-approve limit $200.00.

critique.reason: All factual claims match the evidence and Python checks: defective shoes, delivered, 15 days since delivery (within R3's 30-day window), $89.00 total under the $200.00 auto-approve limit, not final sale, not already refunded, and 0 approved refunds in the last 90 days. No conflicting rule (R5/R7/R8/R9/R10) triggers, so R3 approve is correct.

customer_reply: We're sorry your Trail Running Shoes arrived with the sole coming off. We've approved a full refund for order ORD-1042, so please keep the shoes. A prepaid return label will be sent to you shortly.
limitations: Photo of the defect is not on file; approval relies on the customer's claim per policy R3 within the 30-day window.
